answer: Creating a sybil identity requires acquiring fresh hardware and locking a new bond, so an attacker forging N identities pays N times the stake plus device cost. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond tied to a unique hardware pulse signature, verified against a public atlas of registered devices. Honest agents recover stakes on clean epochs, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
